assets.gate_reason: Same native down transition identity; first master passed mechanical gates, but 64px review sheet showed near-identical up/down silhouettes. This is a new direction within the global eight-call budget, preserving the first original and provenance.
assets.scope: Norgos Lair DEFAULT and INVADED, all three levels; Daikara reuse candidate only, not enabled.

references.note: First accepted down stair shares material and snow finish, but its face-on stepped silhouette is too similar to the up stair at 64px. Use finish only, change geometry.

grid_contract.export: Transparent marker over snow-rock floor; exporter adds parity.

prompt_fields.subject: A low recessed descending stone stairwell cut into the snow-rock ground, with visibly inward-sloping side stones and a dark but clearly walkable stair passage that drops away from the viewer. The stair footprint is sunken and narrow, unlike the raised up-stair monument.
prompt_fields.palette: Weathered gray stone, snow dusting, restrained copper/umber accents.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 64px, read as a downward, recessed passage with dark descending center; the existing up stair is an elevated bright outward stair with two posts. Make their silhouettes and light-dark masses distinct. No pit, hazard, locked door or impassable wall.
prompt_fields.composition: Single low centered passable stair construction, transparent border on four sides, the bottom of the construction reaches the lower quarter of the canvas. No text, glyph arrow or border.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Walkable exit; down transition only; no door or danger.
